parrafo.es: Keyah's Kleaning limpia casas y condominios en Boca Raton con atención al detalle: de la cocina al baño, cada rincón queda revisado antes de irnos.
parrafo.en: Keyah's Kleaning cleans homes and condos across Boca Raton with real attention to detail, from the kitchen to the bathroom, every corner gets checked before we leave.

parrafo_1.es: Keyah's Kleaning es una empresa de limpieza residencial en Boca Raton. Keyah, la dueña, y su equipo limpian casas y condominios con un enfoque en el detalle: no se trata de pasar rápido, sino de dejar cada espacio realmente limpio.
parrafo_1.en: Keyah's Kleaning is a residential cleaning company based in Boca Raton. Keyah, the owner, and her team clean houses and condos with a focus on detail: it is not about moving fast, it is about leaving every space truly clean.

parrafo_2.es: Las reseñas en Google lo confirman: 4.9 de calificación con 60 opiniones, muchas de clientes que habían tenido malas experiencias con otras empresas antes de encontrar a Keyah's Kleaning.
parrafo_2.en: The reviews on Google back it up: a 4.9 rating from 60 reviews, many from clients who had been let down by other companies before finding Keyah's Kleaning.

texto.es: Nos cuentas el tamaño de tu casa o condominio y qué necesitas. Respondemos por teléfono, sin formularios.
texto.en: Tell us the size of your home or condo and what you need. We answer by phone, no forms.

texto.es: Coordinamos un horario que te funcione, dentro del horario de 8 AM a 8 PM, los siete días de la semana.
texto.en: We coordinate a time that works for you, within our 8 AM to 8 PM hours, seven days a week.

texto.es: Keyah y su equipo llegan puntuales y limpian a fondo cada área que pediste, de la cocina al baño.
texto.en: Keyah and her team arrive on time and clean every area you asked for thoroughly, from the kitchen to the bathroom.

texto.es: Antes de irnos repasamos contigo que todo haya quedado como esperabas.
texto.en: Before we leave, we go over everything with you to make sure it is exactly how you wanted it.

nota.es: Cada limpieza se cotiza según el tamaño de tu casa y lo que necesites. Llámanos y te damos el detalle sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every cleaning is quoted based on the size of your home and what you need. Call us and we will walk you through it, no strings attached.

texto.es: Limpiamos casas y condominios completos con atención a cada rincón: cocinas, baños, recámaras y áreas comunes.
texto.en: We clean full homes and condos with attention to every corner: kitchens, bathrooms, bedrooms and common areas.

texto.es: Para cuando acabas de comprar o vas a entregar una propiedad: dejamos el espacio listo para empezar de cero.
texto.en: For when you just bought or are handing over a property: we leave the space ready for a fresh start.

texto.es: Visitas programadas semanales, quincenales o mensuales para mantener tu hogar siempre en orden.
texto.en: Scheduled weekly, biweekly or monthly visits to keep your home consistently in order.

titulo.es: Limpieza profunda de baños y cocina
titulo.en: Deep clean for kitchens and bathrooms

texto.es: Las áreas que más lo necesitan, con el mismo cuidado al detalle que describen nuestras clientas en Google.
texto.en: The areas that need it most, with the same attention to detail our clients describe on Google.

pie.es: ¿No ves exactamente lo que buscas? Llámanos igual, lo cotizamos.
pie.en: Don't see exactly what you need? Call us anyway, we will quote it.

items.quote: Keyah's Kleaning deserves a glowing 5-star review! They worked wonders on our newly bought property, leaving it spotlessly clean. Their team is efficient, professional, and truly masters of their craft. Highly recommend for anyone seeking exceptional cleaning services. Fantastic job!

I used Keyah's cleaning service for the first time today Kelly was the women who cleaned and she did an extraordinary job. I asked for a very detailed cleaning of one Bathroom and one bedroom. Very thorough from top to bottom. I will definitely be recommending this service to friends and family.
Keyah did a great job at my condo. She arrived on time and was very friendly. She has a very good attention to details. I would recommend her company for any cleaning job.
